title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

(Huh...?
Is that An over there?)

rows.Line: An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane?
We don't have practice today... Oh, isn't this your day to practice with Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but we're not supposed to meet for a while. What are you up to, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I was looking for a cat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A cat?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, she's a stray called Vivi. You might've seen her before too, Kohane. You know, the gray tabby with dark stripes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe...
I've definitely seen cats matching that description around here before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
See?
But I haven't seen her in a while...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that she might've moved somewhere else since she's a stray, but I've also been seeing all these trucks moving in and out because of this new shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I hope you find her soon...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I hope so too.
Everybody around here's taken a liking to Vivi, so it just doesn't feel the same without her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, I saw some cats hanging around this place just the other day... Do the people here really like cats or something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Vivi especially since she “understands music”. Because of that, she gets treated kinda special!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean she “understands music”?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know how cats don't really like hearing loud noises? They usually scatter whenever we sing and stuff on the street, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Vivi stops and listens when someone good's singing! Otherwise, she just walks on by like nothing's happening.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, everyone does their best to get Vivi to stay and listen! As a result, they all find ways to get better and better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why she's become known as the “cat that understands music” who's able to turn aspiring talent into fully-fledged musicians.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no way to know if she's actually listening, but it'd be pretty great if it were true, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time.
I have to get back home to help out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll let you know if I see any cats matching that description you gave!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, also... If you still have time until you're supposed to practice with Uncle Taiga, wanna stop by my place? I bought this new CD and was wondering if we could listen to it together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
In that case, I think I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's head on over!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
Kohane, I'll go get the CD now... Huh?
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is someone at the counter crying...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is it that lady...?
Do you think something happened to her?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, An, you're back.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Just in time too. Mind talking to our friend here for a bit? Based on what I was just told, she's in a tough pickle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You want me to talk to...?

*Sob*
What am I supposed to do?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, hold on... Ms. Kawasaki?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, An, you know her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's a freelance photographer.
She took pictures of me when I was little and I got all dressed up for Shichi-Go-San.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ms. Kawasaki!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Huh?
A-An...! It's been so long!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I knew it was you!
What's the matter?
You sound like you're in trouble...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
That's because I am...
I'm supposed to do this big shoot the day after tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: But all of the models I had booked can't make it anymore...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A photography contest?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes...
This year's theme is “happiness”, so my idea was to take photos of a wedding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, a wedding sounds like a great idea! I helped out a little at one a while back, and really liked how the air was filled with so much warmth and kindness...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes, that's exactly what I want to capture! My goal is to get shots of that moment you often see during weddings when “happiness brings everybody together”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When happiness brings everybody together...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes.
That popped into my head when I attended my friend's wedding some time ago.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: There were many guests there, including children and the elderly... All of them seemed so happy when they saw the bride and the groom together too.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
And I had this realization.
“Everybody's there to wish for their happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: That wonderfully miraculous moment is what brought us together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A place where everyone wishes for somebody's happiness... That really is wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you understand!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Which is why I started hiring some models, booking a venue and everything... Then, I received this call yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: It turns out that the modeling agency I contacted is going out of business...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Out of business?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that true...?!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, I couldn't believe it either!
But that's just that and there's nothing I can do about it...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I've been looking everywhere trying to get  ahold of more models, but I'm having trouble finding the right people...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's how you ended up slumped over our counter... I remember back in the day when you used to come here whenever things weren't going so well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hmm... I really wanna help her since I've known her since I was really little.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(What if I introduced Haruka to her...?
Oh, wait. She said she's going somewhere with Minori the day after tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Isn't there anyone out there? A photogenic model with the aura to match...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A photogenic model with the aura to match...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes.
Ideally, someone with a brilliant spark that shows just how full of life they are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A brilliant spark...? Filled to the brim with life...? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you both looking at me like that all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I think you're just the model who Ms. Kawasaki's looking for, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, she's right!
To think that the answer was right under my nose this entire time...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
An, please!
I need you to model for me as a bride!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?!
S-Slow down, Ms. Kawasaki!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have zero experience being a model and I've never worn any fancy dresses before!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: With my works, I value soul more than experience! And you're the very embodiment of that, An!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
So, An, I beg you!
Give me a chance to capture that moment when “happiness brings everybody together”...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: L-Look, I appreciate you saying all this... But I mean...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's important for brides to have an air of maturity and collectedness about them, right? I honestly don't possess any of those qualities...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I've never been a model before...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: No, that's okay! This has nothing to do with experience! I want to photograph you, An!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Please!
Give me a chance to take that really heart-warming shot I'm looking for!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That reminds me of what Ms. Kawasaki told me back when she took my Shichi-Go-San pictures.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's trying to take the best shot possible, just like we're trying to put on the most amazing event ever as musicians.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Just as I'm trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, Ms. Kawasaki's...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Alright, I understand. I'll lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't really guarantee anything, but I'll give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An as a model for a wedding...
That means I'll get to see her dressed as a bride...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Wait, I should've noticed you sooner...!
You're An's friend, no?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Why don't you join us for this shoot?
I was also looking for people to play the part of her friends as her bridesmaids, but having an actual friend there would make it feel all the more real!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Also, you have this look about you, so, I'm sure I'll be able to take some wonderful photos! Think of it as creating some fun memories! C'mon, what do you say?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Umm... W-Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
G-Go easy on her, Ms. Kawasaki!
You're making her panic!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, hello. For lunch today, we have...
The Crase Cafe Special.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, this looks delicious!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's so colorful too.
You've chosen vegetables that are in season.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's plenty to go around, so feel free to ask for seconds.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't help but overhear your conversation just now. That wedding shoot sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you mind showing us some pictures once they're ready? I'm sure everyone will love to see you dressed up as a bride, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's a little embarrassing...
But I'll be sure to send them over once they're done!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck as the bride, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To become a bride that looks mature, beautiful and has this way of making people's heads turn...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...?
Is something wrong, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, the thing is...
I'm kinda worried that I won't be able to play the role of a bride right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You hardly ever say anything this negative.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm not trying to be negative per se...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But I'm a little surprised as well...
I was under the impression that you were ready to dive right in, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I'd probably be fine in any other role, but the bride's bit more special, you know...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A long time ago, I saw an actual bride on Vivid Street...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
On Vivid Street?
Is there a wedding hall around there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They did it at a live house instead of a wedding hall after the groom said he wanted to try doing that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the bride was so unbelievably pretty!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like you, MEIKO!
She seemed so beautiful, mature and collected!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the compliment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I just happened to catch her bouquet after she threw it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, she patted me on the head while saying, “Thank you for catching it.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The look on that lady's face...
She seemed completely in her element, and it made her exude this aura of beauty...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm reminded every time of that moment when I think about what a bride is... I don't really fit the bill, do I?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I'm worried about playing one...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I believe you'll do just fine, Shiraishi...
But you also make a fair point. You may feel more at home escorting others rather than being escorted.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
See?
Just because Ms. Kawasaki's having trouble finding a replacement...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I disagree!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're a wonderful person, An...
So I think you'll make a wonderful bride!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also... I'm sure Ms. Kawasaki thinks that with you as the subject, she can capture the moment when “happiness brings everybody together”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When “happiness brings everybody together”...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, Ms. Kawasaki's trying to photograph the moment when everyone there joins together to genuinely wish for somebody's happiness.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
If that's the case, An, you're the perfect person for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because you're always looking out for Kohane, your team and everyone around town. Isn't that right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In a way, you're always out there wishing for the happiness of others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too!
You clearly care so much about all these different people, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I think you'll be a really wonderful bride!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
I still feel a little embarrassed, but if you two honestly believe that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, MEIKO, Kohane...!
I feel much better about this now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my best to be as real a bride as I can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
I promise to do my best as a bridesmaid too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (As real a bride...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(I'm a bit concerned...
But I hope it's just me overthinking things.)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow, what a great day of shopping!
We got some new cosmetics and should be all set for summer now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, a cat!
It's stripes are so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? But it seems a bit unsettled...
It's okay. We're not here to hurt you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh oh...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Achoo...!
Achoo! Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Airi?
Here, have some tissues.

rows.Speaker: Cat

rows.Line: Oh no, it ran off... It seemed pretty startled...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh! I could actually pet them if it weren't for this condition too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You love cats so much, Airi, but you're sadly allergic to them...

rows.Line:
Hm?
Someone just sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, press here and... Oh.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A person from this agency that I did some modeling work with just sent me a message...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Their photographer friend seems to be in a bit of trouble and is looking for a model who's available tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So they asked me if I'm free and could help out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Interesting.
Did they say what you'd be modeling for?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A wedding as the bride.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's every girl's dream to put on a wedding dress, right? Almost like a chance to become a princess.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And just thinking about you wearing one, Shizuku... I can't even begin to imagine how incredible you're gonna look...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How incredible?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I meant you're gonna look amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I am? Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I might have to accept this offer if you're willing to say this much, Airi... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, mind if I take this opportunity to ask you for a favor?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?
The day of the shoot

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here we are! The wedding hall!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's so pretty...!
I'm sure the photos will turn out really nice too since it's such a nice day! I really should've brought my camera...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You really love photography, huh, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: An! Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Good morning, Ms. Kawasaki!
Wait, who's that next to you...?

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.

rows.Line: Kinuya's an old friend of mine and a dressmaker. She can even make tuxedos!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They were supposed arrive at the same time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't see anyone who looks the part... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, is that...? Vivi...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Darn, so close...!
Gray but no stripes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
I hope we find Vivi soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone around town's worried sick about her too. I wanna see her safe and sound...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll help look!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's not just Vivi. An genuinely cares about everyone around her... She's such a nice person...)
Achoo!

rows.Line: Hm?

Hehe. Thank you, Airi.

rows.Line: Hey, over there. Isn't that...?
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I knew it!
It's Hinomori and Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you're Haruka and Minori's friends... Hang on, Shiraishi and Azusawa, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
Um... I got to chat with you a little during New Year's, Momoi, but this is probably our first time talking, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My name's An Shiraishi. It's nice to finally meet you. I've been friends with Haruka since elementary school and she tells me all about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'm Kohane Azusawa...!
Oh, but Hinomori and I see each other somewhat often at school, so this isn't our first time meeting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, you're right.
My name is Shizuku Hinomori.
I'm looking forward to working with you, Shiraishi, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, what brings you two here...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're supposed to be in the shoot that's taking place here today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? The shoot...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You too, Hinomori, Momoi?
So are we!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
An! Kohane!
What...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Shizuku Hinomori and Airi Momoi...?! But you're idols...! What are you two doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good morning!
We're supposed to doing a shoot here today.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
I'm Kawasaki, the photographer. It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: But I didn't realize other people would be shooting here today. I'll be careful not to get in your way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Speaking of which, Ms. Kawasaki!
Did you manage to get a hold of the groom?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, no...
Would you mind waiting just a little bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku, is someone calling you...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right!
Okay, the accept button should be... This one!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, they picked up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello? This is Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Huh? A woman's voice?!
But I asked for someone to play the groom...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm hearing this strange echo...
Oh no! Did my phone break?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Kawasaki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's really starting to get dark and cloudy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is the shoot still gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, talk about a surprise...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You asked a friend at a modeling agency for someone to play a groom and you got a bride instead...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry!!
I really should've double checked with them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, you shouldn't be apologizing!
I doubt any of us would've saw this coming...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
We don't blame you one bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But what should we do about the shoot...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: About that... We can't exactly proceed without a groom...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: No, wait. That's not entirely true...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Happiness can bring everybody together as long as that feeling's truly genuine. Gender has nothing to do with it!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
I see... Oh, I know!
I have the perfect costume in my car if you don't mind coming with me!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Um...
Well, there they go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose that means we're still going forward with the shoot... I'm glad to hear that things might work out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
I really don't want Ms. Kawasaki's hard work to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
Again, Hinomori, Momoi, we're looking forward to working with you today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, same here!
And you can call us Airi and Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
O-Okay... Airi... Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
If you like, you can call us by our first names too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, An, Kohane.
Let's all do our very best today, okay?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
We have the perfect costume for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is this a tuxedo for women...?
It's wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! It looks so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Having both of you wear dresses would've been nice, but I thought this would help bring out the best in both of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(She's totally right!
Instead of a wedding dress, a tuxedo would suit me much...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: An, you'll be wearing the wedding dress, and Shizuku, you'll be wearing the tuxedo. Kohane, Airi, you'll be wearing the bridesmaids' dresses.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Ms. Kawasaki! I'm gonna be in the dress?!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Shizuku's an actual model and would probably look much better in the dress...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: But I made you this offer because I wanted to see you as the bride, An.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Please, give me a chance to capture that beautiful spark of yours!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My spark? That might be pushing it a bit too far...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Don't worry, An.
I have a feeling that only you will be able to play the bride that Ms. Kawasaki here is hoping to see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Oh, on second thought...
Shizuku's pretty tall, so it's probably better if she wore the tux...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yeah, alright...
I still don't really understand why Ms. Kawasaki wants me to do this so much, but she seems genuinely enthusiastic about this.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll just have to be the best bride I can be...!)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, please get changed and we'll start our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: An, Shizuku, Kinuya's going to help you get dressed and made up in separate rooms, so please wait for her there. Come back to join us once you're ready.

rows.Speaker: An & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
This dress looks amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Let me know once you've put on the stockings and gotten the bustier in more or less the right position. I'll be setting up the dress and pannier.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I didn't realize a pannier had this much volume to it. Mizuki's always saying how skirt's are nice since they're nice and light, but just wearing this is gonna be tough...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (However, I'm trying so many things I've never done before... I'm starting to get excited about this!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-Is something the matter?
Oh, is there something wrong with my dress?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... I had this realization while we were changing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This dress looks so good on you, Kohane! Especially the lace since they kinda look like wings! It's perfect for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-You think so?
I was a little worried since I'd never worn anything like this before, so I'm really glad you said that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You look really amazing too!
This crisp color goes so well with your bright personality, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks!
Hehe. I can't help but feel a little giddy♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That just leaves Shizuku and An!
I can't wait to see how they look!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But Shizuku in a tux...
What do you think that's gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: About that... Shizuku's such a kind and gentle person, so her in a tuxedo... I'm really not sure...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm sure Shizuku's gonna look fine. If anything, she should look really cool!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm sure An's gonna look gorgeous as the bride. I mean, you can't really ask for a better person!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
After her hair and makeup are done, she might transform into really beautiful person...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
An and Shizuku might both change a lot...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Airi
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see them...!
I'm really looking forward to seeing them...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you both for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, sounds like Shizuku's ready!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, how is it wearing a tux for the first...? Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Airi
rows.Line: Whoa!!
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Airi, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I... I don't believe it...!
She's like a prince...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-She's...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's become a lethal weapon...!!
Her amazing looks are too overwhelming...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't you get it?! We're saying that it suits you way too well!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It does? Thank you, Airi!
Those dresses suit you both very well too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I still think I pale in comparison to you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That tuxedo looks incredible by itself, but you wearing it makes it look just that much more stunning... It's like you're putting your model powers on full display!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I alone wouldn't have been able to make this tuxedo seem so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ms. Kinuya told me so herself.
This costume is imbued with the hope that “the wearer can feel a genuine sense of happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That thought is likely what's giving me the ability to shine brighter than usual.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That thought...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Ms. Kinuya did everything for us this time around... But the efforts of the hairstylists, makeup artists, costume designers and such are usually what make what we do a reality.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not just about the ones in the spotlight. A lot of people have to work together to give that person a captivating charm. That's true whether you're a model or an idol!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see... That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, An should be just about ready too.
They were just putting the finishing touches on her hair.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to see her...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Wow...! Shizuku looks so cool...!
I knew it. Real models just have something the rest of us don't...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
Am I really gonna look okay as her partner?)

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: An, what are you stopping at the entrance for? C'mon, this way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Um, right...!

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
E-Everyone, I'm ready...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An!
How's the dress...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my. Isn't she lovely...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That dress and tiara look so good on you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've never worn such a fancy dress before and was worried that I wouldn't be able to play a bride very well... So I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You're...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's wrong, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're so beautiful, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Cute, beautiful and...!
Gorgeous beyond belief!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, Kohane, I get it! I look pretty!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But thanks!
You look really pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
I'm done setting up everything for the shoot and... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
You all look spectacular!
Yes, absolutely perfect!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
So, let's start the shoot.
Please come join me in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yikes! I stepped on the hem!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, at this rate, I'm gonna fall...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you okay, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Shizuku?!
Y-Your face... It's so close...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I thought you were about to fall, so I jumped in to help...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one apologizing!
I accidentally stepped on the hem...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
More importantly, An, are you hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-I'm okay...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
Our much-awaited wedding would've been all for naught if our bride were to get injured.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'm really glad you're okay, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wh-Whoa...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The prince saved the princess! It's straight out of a fairytale...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I get why she'd be overwhelmed...
Shizuku kinda has a habit of getting up close and personal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Alright, An, shall we?
Why don't we lock arms on our way over?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It might be because she's in a dress, but An seems to be acting a little different than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me of what she said...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like you, MEIKO!
She seemed so beautiful, mature and collected!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Is that what's going on...?
Hehe. You're so adorable, An...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Geez, talk about a surprise!
My heart's racing because Shizuku's so pretty and literally right next to me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(She's so amazing...
So mature and can pull off something like a tux.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, that means I've gotta do my best too...!)
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we start by taking some photos of the bride and the bridesmaids.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Bridesmaids are supposed to assist the bride, but they're also usually the bride's closest friends. You don't necessarily have to pose like we're taking formal wedding photos.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I'd rather have you all smile and have fun together in a way that shows others the moment when “happiness brings everybody together”!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, the shoot's really about to start...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(A-Am I gonna be okay...?
Shizuku looks so cool, and An and Airi both look really adorable... Plus, I'm not used to having anyone other than Dad take photos of me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, are you pretty nervous about this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I really like taking photos, but I'm really not used to actually being in them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, I get that.
It's not that I dislike this or anything, but I'm a little nervous too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You'll be fine, Kohane!
Just smile!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right!
Okay...! Smile... Smile...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A-Are we gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin with a few test shots! First, Airi, mind holding An's hand for me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
An, ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, that's good! You two seem like old friends. Next, Kohane, can you take Airi's spot for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've got this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-After I take her hand... What sort of expression should I be making...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
You could try remembering a time when An looked visibly happy and you felt really glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
When I felt glad for her...?
B-But that's happened so much...
I don't know which memory to go with...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you're such a straight arrow.
It's okay, just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Not to mention that it's your first time being a model. How about we take some photos with just you to get you used to being in front of the lens?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kohane seems a bit tense.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I hope she finds a way to shake those nerves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if we did some stretches or something else that can help her relax a little...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Relax, huh...?
Oh, An, can I borrow you for a sec?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka mentioned how you two are really close. If that's true, why not...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...is what I wanna try.
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I see...
Okay! Let's give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh dear. You seem more nervous when you're by yourself. I apologize for asking so much of you.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Let's try taking these a different way.
Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No... My face is totally freezing up...!
I have to find a way to smile fast...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But how...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ms. Kawasaki!
Would it be alright if the three of us tried doing this pose we like together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have a feeling that it'll look more natural, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand...
Okay, I don't mind you doing this pose of yours.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay... Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! Wh-What's going on, Airi?
Why are you hugging An all of a sudden...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After discussing things with An, we decided to literally get closer to each other!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! And now we look like best friends!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh... What say you, Kohane?!
Are you gonna let me hog An all to myself?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Congratulations, An!
You getting married really brings a tear to my eye...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And close it out by really squeezing her tight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Th-Thank you, Airi!
I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... S-So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Kohane, go get her!
This might be your last chance ever to hug her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-My last chance...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But... Noooo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wah! Ko-Kohane... You're crushing me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, no fair!
I'm not letting you have all the fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You have such a beautiful smile on your face now, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, your smiles are so lovely...!
I can sense your exuberance from here!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Just keep that going while I take a few more shots!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
We must've gotten in a year's worth of hugs just now♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But it was kind of embarrassing too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Kohane, the expressions you made were so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about surprising you like that, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we believed that it was the best way to get you to relax a little more, so we decided to have some fun to lighten things up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay! I feel so much more relaxed because of what you did, Airi! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
In that case, great!
There really is nothing better than when everyone's smiling!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Kohane found a way to relax. I feel a lot better now compared to earlier too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And the way Airi lightened up the mood in a flash was so incredible... It's like proof that she's really an idol!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, I have to keep this up and get in some good shots with Shizuku!)

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...
se_event_happiness_2022_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Did a cat just meow?
Is it the same cat from before?

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Oh, I heard from the staff here that some cats have taken up residence around this hall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Everyone, let's move to our next location!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, be right there!!
se_event_happiness_2022_004
Outside the chapel

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Next, we'll finally be shooting in front of the chapel! Are you ready, An, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready as well!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, I feel much more relaxed after that last scene, so I should be good to go...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna be the most mature and beautiful bride I can be!)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start with you two coming face to face with the chapel in the background.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I really want you two to wish for each other's happiness here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wishing for each other's happiness, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When she puts it that way, I'm not really sure what kind of face to make while looking at her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That's incredible...
Shizuku's already in character.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That means I have to quit worrying and just try...! Be a calm, collected and mature bride...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a nice pose...
Let me take a few more!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Alright, Shizuku...
Mind escorting An down the stairs for me next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, okay!
se_event_happiness_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: An, hold your skirt with your left hand and... Yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Awesome...!
I'm finally getting the hang of this...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (An seemed pretty nervous until a moment ago, but she seems all better now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(However... What is this I'm feeling...?
